name: sleek
summary: Todo.txt manager with a clean interface, filters, recurring tasks, due dates and dark mode
description: sleek is a desktop app for the todo.txt format. Your tasks stay in a plain text file you can edit anywhere, while sleek adds a searchable list with filters for contexts, projects, priorities and due dates, recurring tasks, threshold dates, drag and drop, multiple files and a dark theme. It works with files synced through any cloud or git.
